answer: Synchrony-premium permits (SPP): each action commits to a target window and a coordination tag. Permits for a window are sold from a shared vault by a clock auction; price rises with the number of distinct tags in that window. A rotating dune seed defines windows, and a small ember surcharge applies to each extra tag entering an already-contested window. To coordinate N sybils in one window, an attacker must buy N permits, paying convex congestion plus N ember surcharges; splitting windows cuts price but destroys synchrony.
